metadata.case_name: LAI YIP NGAN v. 馬志文 AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: Right periorbital soft tissue injury with conjunctival haemorrhage
source: According to the medical report dated 15 October 2014, physical examination showed that there was periorbital swelling over the plaintiff’s right eye and there was a 3 cm deep laceration over the plaintiff’s right calf, with depth down to muscle layer.
According to the medical report dated 10 October 2014, the plaintiff suffered right periorbital bruise with tenderness and small conjunctival haemorrhage.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of eyeball or orbital tissues

source: X-ray examination of the plaintiff’s right shoulder, hip, tibia, pelvis and skull showed that there was fracture over right proximal humerus.
X-ray examination of the plaintiff’s right shoulder showed fracture of her right proximal humerus with minimal displacement.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of upper end of humerus, unspecified site

injuries.description: Full thickness laceration of right posterior calf (3 cm deep, down to muscle) with resulting scarring
injuries.body_part: right posterior calf / right lower leg
source: According to the medical report dated 15 October 2014, physical examination showed that there was periorbital swelling over the plaintiff’s right eye and there was a 3 cm deep laceration over the plaintiff’s right calf, with depth down to muscle layer.
According to the medical report dated 10 October 2014, the plaintiff suffered ... right calf full thickness skin laceration on right posterior calf.
Exploration and repair of right calf wound was performed on 30 March 2014.
According to the medical report dated 26 September 2014, physical examination showed that there was a right calf laceration wound healed with scaring.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of lower leg

manifestations.description: Sense of coldness over her right shoulder
Discomfort over her right shoulder (worse at night and in rainy weather)
Range of movement of her right shoulder was significantly limited by pain
Permanent scars on her right lower leg
Mild swelling of the plaintiff's right lower leg

treatments_received.treatment: Exploration and repair of right calf wound (surgical)
source: Exploration and repair of right calf wound was performed on 30 March 2014.

treatments_received.treatment: Collar and cuff immobilisation for right shoulder fracture
source: Collar and cuff was given to the plaintiff for immobilization of her fracture right shoulder.

treatments_received.treatment: Physiotherapy (referred to physiotherapy sessions from 21 May 2014 to 30 May 2014; attended two sessions)
source: According to the physiotherapy report dated 12 September 2014, the plaintiff was referred to physiotherapy sessions from 21 May 2014 to 30 May 2014. She only attended two sessions of physiotherapy because she was also receiving bone-setting treatments from April to June 2014.
She only attended two sessions of physiotherapy because she was also receiving bone-setting treatments from April to June 2014.
She was given medication for pain relief and was referred to physiotherapist for limbs physiotherapy.

losses.description: Weakness, numbness, sense of coldness and discomfort over right shoulder
Permanent scars on right lower leg from calf laceration
Range of movement of right shoulder significantly limited by pain
